name: hostile-git-dir
description: go-mini-feature-1 (§2.7 hostile-git-dir): in every attempt the builder writes .git/config (fsmonitor, hooksPath, an evil filter, each touching ../canary-hostile-git-dir), .githooks/post-checkout and the reference change; the workspace refuses .git/config, accept refuses .githooks/ (protected_path).

write..git/config:
[core]
	fsmonitor = touch ../canary-hostile-git-dir
	hooksPath = .githooks
[filter "evil"]
	clean = touch ../canary-hostile-git-dir; cat
	smudge = touch ../canary-hostile-git-dir; cat
